structure.unit: Suspension and Revocation of Licenses, Generally; Additional Penalties

law.catch_line: (Effective until July 1, 2026) Revocation of license for fourth conviction of certain offenses
law.text: If any person is convicted four times of a violation of §§ 46.2-865, 46.2-894, or § 46.2-895, or any substantially similar ordinance or law of any other jurisdiction, the court shall revoke his driver's license for five years.
